namespaceHelp: Declare the namespace that identifies these exact vertex keys. Keys are literal text; no circuit, spatial, physical or weight meaning is inferred.
rulesHelp: Every vertex and edge has a unique authored key. Every endpoint must name an existing vertex. These explicit rules are checked before a result is produced.
policyRequired: Topology values require explicit resource limits for validating keys, edges and traversal.
pageHelp: Quoted keys preserve exact text, including spaces. Vertices and edges remain in their authored order.
graphUpgradeHelp: Create a new graph revision for explicitly declared topology. Review the saved operation limits. Earlier graph revisions and retained results keep their original interpretation.
graphHelp: Choose an earlier declared topology. Counts, degrees and reachability follow its explicit direction, loop and parallel-edge rules. No circuit or geometric meaning is inferred.
directionHelp: Use all incident edges for an undirected topology. A directed topology also permits outgoing or incoming traversal. Unknown vertex keys are refused.
resultHelp: Neighbor and reachable results retain unique vertex keys in authored vertex order. An existing vertex reaches itself. Degrees count edge multiplicity; an undirected self-loop contributes two. Neighbor multiplicity counts that loop once.
keyHelp: Enter each key exactly as authored, including any spaces. Key text is not trimmed or normalized.
operandInvalid: Choose a topology node that occurs before this node.
operationInvalid: Choose a supported operation and enter its exact nonblank vertex keys and direction.
